coordinateSystem: Unfitted Blender author coordinates; Z up.
method: Inspected all 59 existing isometric renders, then source geometry at suspicious locations. Verified all 18 before/after drafts and final compressed-GLB renders. No AI calls.
limitations: This is an asset facade audit, not a physical phone performance test.
Every asset has an isometric image review; rear/hidden-side issues additionally checked from source geometry, not claimed to have individual rear renders.

issues.location: large(), lower front facade and skyscraper_2 upper facade
issues.rootCause: A second arcade is overlaid on the windows already built by wide_block; two generic entry columns also lie over the central ground-floor windows.
issues.fix: Removed only the redundant arcade and these two harbor entrance columns; kept all walls, roofs, balconies, windows and canvas awnings.

issues.rootCause: Classic automatic upstairs window and manual window occupy the same plane. Harbor manual window starts at the wall top and intersects the roof without a dormer body. Default shutters are wider than the narrow tower and the rear ground-floor window intersects its rear door.
issues.fix: Removed the extra manual window; added compact_windows only at teleport_gate call sites: narrow windows, no shutters, and a centered rear door with no competing ground-floor window.

issues.location: prestige_core() and prestige_large() facade behind attached round towers
issues.rootCause: Complete rectangular facade windows are built before the new round towers; their flat frames remain in front of portions of the curved wall and intersect the new tower windows.
issues.fix: Omitted the replaced original front windows only, retained round tower windows and mass, and omitted villa tower side windows buried against the existing side facade.

issues.rootCause: Default width .32 with height h/floors-.28 yields window heights .15/.15/.06, less than the arch radius .16, so arch_ring creates negative-height jambs.
issues.fix: Scoped window dimensions and offset to each small drum: villa/hotel width .18 height .23 offset .10; chance width .14 height .16 offset .09. Drum and roof sizes unchanged.

issues.location: lighthouse() upper windows on left/right/back sides
issues.rootCause: rounded_tower auto upper windows overlap three separately authored taller upper windows at the same horizontal centers.
issues.fix: Skipped only the three replaced automatic upper windows; retained manual upper windows, the front window, lighthouse bodies and animated waterwheel.

issues.location: civic_hall bell-tower posts and pergola legs
issues.rootCause: Some supports were positioned from a nominal roof height rather than the actual roof beneath the feet.
issues.fix: Extended civic posts down to 2.10; centered onsen pergolas over the wing roofs (y=.54) and extended feet to 1.34; extended tower2 legs to terrace level. All canopy tops and major building mass retained.

issues.location: Attached round-tower windows behind rectangular body
issues.rootCause: Buried lower tower windows still project sills through the main flat facade. On tower2 the existing side-wall window also occupies the new round tower facade.
issues.fix: Skipped buried hotel lower tower windows and skyscraper lower two tower window rows; kept roof-level visible tower windows. Skipped tower2 right rear flat-wall window column, which is replaced by the round tower.

retainedIntentionalFeatures.reason: Their ground arcade is a genuine forward porch with columns standing on the plinth, not a second frame pasted across upper-floor windows.
Regular bonded corner quoins and cornice dentils contact the wall and remain coherent architectural details; not removed indiscriminately.
The full-height column portico has a base and a supported pediment, unlike the removed duplicate flat arcade.
Animated wheel/crane structures and their animation pivots are functional features and retained.

coverage.fitNote: The over-wide window ornaments were removed; the unchanged authored building is automatically fitted about 1.08% larger inside the same 1.04-wide envelope.
